name: io.github.TinySuiteHQ/tinysearch
description: Fast discovery search and self-hosted web research for MCP agents.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport to serve: stdio (default), sse, or streamable-http.

environmentVariables.name: TINYSEARCH_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a tinysearch_config.json inside the container, for overriding search/embedding defaults.

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: SearXNG search endpoint URL. Only needed if not using the bundled Compose SearXNG service.

environmentVariables.name: TINYSEARCH_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Local ONNX preset (fast, balanced, quality) or a Hugging Face ONNX repository id.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: OpenTelemetry service.name resource attribute; defaults to tinysearch.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Common OTLP endpoint for optional TinySearch traces and metrics.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Optional authentication or routing headers for the OTLP exporter.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER
environmentVariables.description: Set to otlp to enable traces explicitly or none to disable them.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
environmentVariables.description: Set to otlp to enable metrics explicitly or none to disable them.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set true to disable all OpenTelemetry signals.
